title: Final descent height
description: Essential: The answer must be the correct expression for the descent height: h = (2Mg l) / (p0 S + Mg).

title: Final gas pressure
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be p0 (atmospheric pressure).

title: Force balance equilibrium
description: Important: The solution must apply static equilibrium to find the gas pressure when vertical: pS = p0 S + Mg.

title: Isothermal process application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Boyle's law (pV constant) for the initial rotation, relating p0, l, p, and h.

title: Process identification for cooling
description: Important: The solution must identify that after descent, cooling first occurs at constant volume until the piston hits the baffles.

title: Temperature comparison step
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate and compare the temperature when the piston reaches the baffles to T0/2.

title: Isochoric pressure calculation
description: Important: The solution must apply Charles's/Gay-Lussac's law (p/T constant) for the constant-volume cooling to find the final pressure.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect force balance (e.g., pS = p0 S - Mg) or misidentifying the process (e.g., assuming isobaric cooling).

title: Volume or length mistake
description: Pitfall: Using incorrect initial/final volumes (e.g., using 2l instead of 2l - h for the gas column after descent).
